Nestled in the picturesque setting of Lake Tegernsee, Juwelier Hollfelder blends tradition, craftsmanship, and timeless elegance. For over 65 years, our family-owned business has been synonymous with exceptional service, exclusive jewelry, and the finest timepieces from renowned brands. Our boutique in Rottach-Egern is a place of genuine hospitality, defined by understated luxury and an inviting atmosphere. With a deep passion for quality and a commitment to our values, we create unique experiences that last a lifetime—because at Hollfelder, we believe there is nothing more valuable than beautiful memories.
#MakingMemories

Tegernsee is where unique nature meets a special attitude of life and where the spiritual Shamballa energy meets the familiar Hollfelder philosophy.

Individuality, strength and spirituality - we totally identify with the special characteristics of a Shamballa jewelry piece. We love the uniqueness of every personality and want to give our guests the opportunity to find their own individual style.

For our customers Shamballa offers the opportunity to design their own essence in a piece of jewelry. We share the joy of creating, designing and finally wearing the Shamballa jewel as a daily companion. For us, Shamballa creates not only pieces for eternity. Together with Shamballa we create beautiful moments, that will be in our memories forever.

Our special store combines contrasts like old wood and modern interior, comfort and luxury – we love to play with the beautiful contrasts of life, exactly like Shamballa does. Where else can you find a rough diamond in combination with a macramé strap? For us beauty lies in simplicity and in the eye of the beholder.

We are looking forward to welcome our guests and give them the feeling of coming home at lake Tegernsee. Make your own memory with the Hollfelder Team and Shamballa.

For over 65 years, Juwelier Hollfelder has been a symbol of craftsmanship, tradition, and exclusivity. Nestled in the charming town of Rottach-Egern, the family-owned boutique offers exquisite jewelry and world-class timepieces from renowned brands.
